leah.arch: Follow-up RFC: staged shard streaming + handshake for airgapped appliances. goal: enable fast "serve-in-minimum-mode" during large model replaces. sharing initial design sketch, want quick feedback on verifier handshake and GC behavior.
omar.runtime: high level please?
leah.arch: plan: split bundle into (manifest + core-weights) + shard catalog. node downloads core first, starts a tiny runtime that can answer low-latency queries. remaining shards stream in background. promotion to full model is an explicit state transition.
julia.ops: what's the smallest "core" we accept in prod? we need an SLA table.
leah.arch: core should be ~<1GB, Q4 quantized skeleton or distilled prefix model. acceptable for low-complexity completions, not for long-context generation. we'll define quality buckets.
kevin.storage: storage concerns: partially downloaded shards + filesystem fragmentation. prefer write-to-temp then atomic rename on verification. also sticky pointers for retention.
leah.arch: verifier-bot: any suggestions for handshake?
verifier-bot: Recommend three-step handshake: 1) manifest verify (signature + manifest hash) 2) catalog fetch (signed index) 3) per-shard streamed verify using chunked checksums. Emit attestation token after successful verify.
omar.runtime: where does attestation live? kernel or agent?
julia.ops: ops wants attestation available to console for routing decisions. also must expire after short TTL.
leah.arch: propose attestation be issued by on-device verifier and cached in agent. control-plane can query it and request re-verify.
kevin.storage: GC policy idea: maintain pin states: pinned (current active + core), staging (in-progress), retained (recently active). each has TTL and disk-quota. GC never reclaims pinned.
julia.ops: rollback UX: honest & quick commands please. `agent resume|promote|rollback --manifest=<sha>` with idempotency and clear exit codes.
omar.runtime: runtime API: /v1/model/mode -> [core, streaming, full], /v1/model/promotion -> current progress percent. Controllers consume these endpoints.
leah.arch: compatibility with older onprem agents? bundles include legacy-flag. older agents get the monolithic archive. new bundles are hybrid.
kevin.storage: dedupe: we should content-address shards to allow cross-model reuse. add ledger for refcounts. risks: tenant cleanup must update refs atomically.
julia.ops: monitoring: metrics to emit: shard_stream_kbps, chunk_verify_errors, staged_disk_pct, promotion_latency_seconds, attestation_age_seconds. Alerts for high chunk_verify_errors or promotion_latency > SLO.
omar.runtime: failover behaviour: while in core mode, route heavy requests to hosted or degrade features. we need pluggable routing policy.
leah.arch: security: signed manifests + per-shard chunk sigs vs stream-MAC. tradeoff: per-chunk sigs increase overhead but permit early abort on corruption.
kevin.storage: implement streaming verify as: read chunk -> compute HMAC with rotating key -> compare expected. store small chunk-index for resume.
julia.ops: test matrix: low bandwidth (5-20Mbps), high-latency (200ms), power-failure during rename, partial-corruption, multi-version shard reuse. write automation for these.
leah.arch: open questions: 1) canonical attestation format 2) default retention TTLs 3) how to surface quality probe plugin interface to ops.
omar.runtime: would be neat to expose probe plugin as WASM so teams can ship domain checks safely.
kevin.storage: agreed, WASM sandbox for probe code is nice. need CPU quota enforcement.
julia.ops: action items: - julia: draft playbook for stuck promotions and alerts (due Mon) - omar: implement /model/promotion endpoint prototype (PR by next week) - kevin: GC/refcount rough spec (draft) - leah: update RFC with handshake sequence and attestation schema.
leah.arch: thanks. drop edge cases here: power loss mid-stream, multi-tenant dedupe conflict, corrupted index. I'll fold into updated doc.
verifier-bot: CI run: https://ci.redwood.internal/rlm/stage-stream/87 - failing on chunk-timeouts at 10Mbps emulation.
julia.ops: noted, will add slower link tests.
omar.runtime: I'll queue a spike to simulate rename+powerfail recovery.
leah.arch: thanks all, adding this to Friday arch sync agenda.
